speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly how the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started, and have you noticed any recent injuries or insect bites to that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That mechanism of injury strongly suggests a "Jersey finger" or a tendon avulsion. Can you demonstrate whether you are able to actively flex the tip of your right ring finger down toward your palm?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the mechanism of injury and your inability to flex the fingertip, this is highly suggestive of a Jersey finger caused by a flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion. I am going to confirm the diagnosis with imaging. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray Right Hand

DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey finger (Flexor Digitorum Profundus avulsion)

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
